entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: The greatest assistance we offer here[n]to you is Persona Fusion...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: It is an ancient ritual by which Personas[n]in your possession are combined to[n]form a new one.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: This ritual is the birth of your new self...[n]while also being the execution of your[n]former existence.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: The resulting Persona from a fusion will[n]surely be stronger than the composite[n]ones.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: However, you will lose any Personas[n]used for the ritual.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Furthermore, given that you use[n]multiple Personas to create only one,[n]your stock will decrease...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: *chuckle* You may wish to consider[n]well what you gain and what you lose[n]from fusion before partaking...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Think carefully about the Confidant[n]bonds you have formed...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: They are closely connected to your[n]heart, and by association, the Personas[n]that dwell within it.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Fuse a Persona of your Confidant bond's[n]arcana, and it will gain experience...[n]perhaps, even levels.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: The higher the Confidant's Rank, of[n]course, the more experience your[n]Persona will earn.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Perhaps now you truly understand[n]the value of a bond with a fine, trusted[n]Confidant...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Allow me to explain the Arcana Burst[n]in a little more detail.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: The power you receive from an Arcana[n]Burst is called Burst Points.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: By spending Burst Points, you can grant[n]yet further power to your Persona in[n]any way you please.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Will you temper their strengths?[n]Or shield their vulnerabilities?[n]The choice is yours alone...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Take note that abilities raised with[n]Burst Points do not grow through[n]leveling up.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Take care that you consider each of[n]your options carefully before you[n]conduct a fusion.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Traits are the individual qualities that[n]a Persona may possess. There are[n]numerous kinds with various effects...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: They are inheritable during fusion,[n]but only one may be inherited at[n]a time...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Keep this in mind whenever you[n]perform a fusion.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Furthermore, there are also rare cases[n]where you cannot pass on a Trait, or[n]a new Trait will appear mid-inheritance.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: There does appear to be some method[n]to the madness, though. Perhaps you can[n]eventually comprehend how it works?

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Of course, there is more than one way[n]to fuse Personas.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: You have other rituals at your disposal[n]besides the standard guillotine.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Ah, but you must no doubt be well[n]familiar with these by now, yes?[n]*chuckle*

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Personas born from fusion can inherit[n]some of the skills of their source[n]Personas.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Simply put, it is possible to create[n]Personas with skills they would[n]ordinarily never learn.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Full understanding is best achieved in[n]practice, but I will provide some simple[n]guidance...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Firstly, the more skills the base Personas[n]have, the more skills you may inherit...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: You shall have your choice of which[n]skills shall be passed on... to an extent.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: However, be aware that some Personas[n]and some skills may never intertwine...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: If you wish to create Personas of[n]unmatched power, I suggest you[n]remember this well.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: I must apologize, but even our ritual[n]is not foolproof.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: We have been known to have rare cases[n]in which... "accidents" may occur.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: These fusion accidents may cause an[n]entirely unexpected Persona to be[n]born instead.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: The results of such accidents are beyond[n]even our predictions... One must expect[n]the unexpected.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: The Guillotine Search allows you to[n]view what Personas you can fuse with[n]what you currently possess.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Even should the results be identical,[n]you will be able to see all possible[n]combinations.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Ah, but you have come so far... I suspect[n]you are far beyond such fundamentals,[n]hmm?

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Allow me to explain the fusion[n]known as Group Guillotine.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: You do not pick from individual[n]Personas, but rather select a[n]predetermined combination.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: They will all require three or more[n]Personas, but the end result may be[n]truly one of a kind.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: This type of fusion is guaranteed to[n]grant you a Persona of remarkable[n]strength...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Perhaps this will serve you in the battles[n]to come, hmm?

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: In worlds adjacent to our own, other[n]thieves strive against the very same[n]trials you face...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: By combining resources with the thieves[n]beyond, you may perform a Public[n]Execution fusion.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: You select a Persona from your own[n]stock to fuse with a Persona chosen[n]by another such thief...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: I'm sure you understand the potential[n]of performing fusions with Personas[n]that you yourself do not yet possess...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: It is a most enticing means of fusion—[n]one that at times can even produce skills[n]unobtainable with any other method.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: However, Public Execution is not to be[n]abused... Such a ritual can be performed[n]only once daily.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Remember the limits imposed on you.[n]Only once per day...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Your time is running out, it seems...[n]Consider your final gambits carefully.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Allow me to explain the use of[n]the Gallows.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: It is a ritual of sacrificing a Persona to[n]another, gaining power and retaining[n]form...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: This is not so much a fusion, you see,[n]as it is an offering.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: If the Persona and the sacrifice are of[n]the same arcana, it will earn even more[n]experience.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: If you sacrifice a Treasure Demon,[n]the recipient will gain a massive[n]amount of experience.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: To fuse, or to sacrifice... How will you[n]decide their fates?

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Points earned on the Gallows are[n]"Burst Points."

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Do you remember? These are the same[n]Burst Points as the ones you earn when[n]fusing.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: By sacrificing, you allot Burst Points to[n]Personas even after creating them.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: And of course you can earn "Burst Skills"[n]as well by allotting the requisite points.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Burst Skills will be a great help to you.[n]Use them well.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: You cannot offer a sacrifice to a Persona[n]twice in succession.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Such a flood of power would be more[n]than the Persona could bear. Your[n]limit is once per day.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: That being said, this does not seem[n]to be the case during a Fusion Alarm.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: However, do be aware of the potential[n]for accidents if you repeatedly fuse[n]Personas during an alarm.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: With the Electric Chair, you may sacrifice[n]a Persona to an item, embedding its[n]spirit within.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Offering a living sacrifice to an inanimate[n]object... Cruel, perhaps, and even[n]idolatrous...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: However, the process is sure to result in[n]an item of incomparable value.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: All manner of items can be powered up:[n]from weapons to accessories.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Try your hand, and see what wonders[n]you can create.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Allow me to introduce the Fusion Alarm,[n]designed to inspire your will of rebellion.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: These occur after completing a battle.[n]The more battles you win and masks you[n]obtain, the more likely the occurrence.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Fusions performed during an alarm will[n]grant more power to the results than[n]usual, and also potentially alter skills.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Special executions performed during[n]an alarm are also similarly improved.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: However, be wary of performing the[n]same ritual too many times, as it may[n]cause an unpredictable fusion accident.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: On the other hand, if you wish to witness[n]the unknown and discover new power,[n]then feel free to induce such accidents.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Taking your leave after an execution[n]will end the alarm period. You can also[n]end it by speaking with Lavenza.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: It is a curious tendency of man to[n]personify items of power and[n]ascribe souls to them.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: This subconscious idea is what gave rise[n]to the Shadows known as Treasure[n]Demons...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: You cannot summon them in battle,[n]as you would a normal Persona.[n]Their purpose lies in fusion.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: In using Treasure Demons, you may[n]drastically change what Persona may[n]arise from a given fusion.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: It appears the fusion's result[n]would somehow rely on arcana...[n]but I can offer no specifics.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Treasure Demons may prove useful[n]in fusions other than the Guillotine,[n]as well.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Their mysteries are yours to discover.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: You may choose to place one of your[n]Personas into solitary confinement[n]where it can undergo special "training."

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Only one Persona may undergo this[n]training at a time, though.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: In addition, this Persona will be[n]unavailable for battle or fusions[n]during its confinement.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: After the day has passed, the Persona[n]in Lockdown will grow stronger.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: With enough time, the Persona will[n]also learn how to "purge itself of[n]weakness."

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: The higher the Confidant rank for[n]that Persona's arcana, the sooner[n]the purging will occur.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Nurturing your bonds with others will[n]grant even greater strength to your[n]Personas—please do not forget that.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Solitary confinement is a place to face[n]oneself and grow. Burning an incense[n]may allow for even greater focus...

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: The incense will take effect after the[n]day has passed—but remember, you[n]can only burn one incense at a time.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Once the effect has taken place, you may[n]light another incense. Make good use of[n]this to further strengthen your Personas.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Incense can be found not only in the[n]Metaverse, but in your world as well.[n]Stay vigilant in your search for them.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: While it may be locked away, a Persona[n]is still a part of your heart.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Should you leave it in Lockdown for[n]too long, it may potentially disappear.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: I will give you a sole warning before it[n]disappears. Should you fail to take action,[n]you must prepare for the consequences.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Personas possess unique properties[n]known as Traits.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: These traits can be passed on through[n]fusion.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: With proper planning, you could come[n]to possess a nigh-unstoppable Persona.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: However, some rare Traits cannot be[n]inherited, so do keep that in mind.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: But no matter what, only one Trait[n]can be passed along at a time, so[n]make your choice carefully.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: You can register your Persona's[n]name and abilities in this[n]Persona Compendium I carry.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Registered Personas can be restored[n]to your stock for a price.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: I will automatically register any[n]unrecorded Personas you bring to me.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: I can easily overwrite an entry if you[n]have a more powerful version of[n]a Persona.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Registering is free. You may request to[n]do so at any time.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: However, if you wish to summon one,[n]I must request a fee based on its strength.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Do you understand now?

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: While it may be possible to summon[n]Personas from the Compendium during[n]an alarm, you must exercise caution.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: The exact reason for this is unknown, but[n]withdrawing Personas seems to make[n]unforeseeable accidents more likely.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: As such, you must take care when using[n]the Compendium in the midst of a[n]Fusion Alarm.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Normally, this Persona would be[n]too powerful for you to handle...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: It would seem, however, we do not have[n]the luxury to be strict. We shall help you[n]as well.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: If you have [clr 3][var 0][clr 27] yen, then I will[n]perform the fusion... Is that acceptable?
Do it.
I'll pass.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: It appears this Persona will require[n]summoning from the Persona[n]Compendium.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: I shall summon it for you if you pay[n][clr 3][var 0][clr 27] yen. What will you do?
Do it.
I'll pass.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: When a Fusion Alarm is active, the[n]effects of a fusion are stronger than[n]normal.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: However, relying upon the same[n]execution equipment too often may[n]lead to results that you aren't expecting.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: The next execution seems like it will[n]be rather risky... The results could very[n]well turn out differently than expected.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: The newly born Persona is temporarily[n]overflowing with power.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Using this Persona in a fusion ritual may[n]well produce results that are outside[n]your expectations.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Should you wish to brave the unknown[n]in your search for power, then perhaps[n]embracing such uncertainty could help.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: The Guillotine has grown unstable...[n]Be wary of performing any further[n]executions with this equipment.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Something has gone amiss with the[n]Gallows... Be wary of performing any[n]further executions with this equipment.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: The Electric Chair is not performing as[n]expected... Be wary of performing any[n]further executions with this equipment.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: I believe the execution equipment can[n]no longer take any more... Please allow[n]me to bring the alarm to an end.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: I must perform equipment maintenance,[n]so I will now ask you to take your leave.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: The result was rather unexpected,[n]but is it still to your liking?

entries.en: By sacrificing multiple Personas[n]to a single Persona, you can power[n]up that Persona's stats.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: You can execute a single Persona[n]and have it transform into an item.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: You can leave a Persona here[n]for a certain amount of days[n]and earn experience points.

entries.speaker: Velvet Resident
entries.en: Welcome... to the Velvet Room.

entries.speaker: Velvet Resident
entries.en: Level up your Confidant rank with[n]the Velvet residents to be able to[n]customize fusion results by bribing.
